title: Part 15 : 2019: Ceramic Tiles — Methods of Test, Sampling and Basis for Acceptance Part 15 Sampling and Basis for Acceptance ( First Revision )
clause_1_scope: This standard (Part 15) defines rules for batching, sampling, inspection and acceptance/rejection. It applies to unfixed ceramic tiles that have been stored under cover.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Ceramic Tiles — Definitions, Classifications, Characteristics and Marking ( Second Revision )
to 15: Ceramic Tiles - Methods of Test, Sampling and Basis for Acceptance

clause_3_terminology: Sampling and Basis for Acceptance Part 15 Sampling and Basis for Acceptance

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
